instruction: Enable Sticky Keys and rename the following files on the Desktop: draft1.txt to report1.txt, draft2.txt to report2.txt, and draft3.txt to report3.txt.
gt_steps: Open File Explorer and navigate to the Desktop.
Leave the renamed files on the Desktop.

command: echo File 1 > C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\draft1.txt && echo File 2 > C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\draft2.txt && echo File 3 > C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\draft3.txt

result.command: cmd /c if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\report1.txt if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\report2.txt if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\report3.txt if not exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\draft1.txt if not exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\draft2.txt if not exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\draft3.txt echo SUCCESS
